changelog:
gogs skill — version 1.0.0

- Initial release providing `gog`: a Google Workspace CLI and unified API for 50+ AI models.
- Supports Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Contacts, Sheets, and Docs management from the command line.
- Integrates multi-provider access to models for image, video, music generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, chat, web search, document parsing, email, and SMS.
- Features direct model calls by ID and “smart routing” to auto-select the best or cheapest option per task.
- Includes bash usage examples and parameter references for all major API functions.
summary: Google Workspace CLI for Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Contacts, Sheets, and Docs. And also 50+ models for image generation, video generation, text-to-speech, spee...
